desc.en: Free for installation on unlimited number of devices(for personal use) and allows up to 20 connections to a single device at once. (great for gaming/low latency work)
desc.zh: 可在不限数量的设备上免费安装（个人用途），并允许单台设备同时最多 20 个连接。（非常适合游戏/低延迟工作）

desc.en: Free for 3 devices, no limits on the number and duration of sessions
desc.zh: 3 台设备免费，会话数量和时长不受限制

desc.en: Free for 2 devices, no limits on the number and duration of sessions
desc.zh: 2 台设备免费，会话数量和时长不受限制

desc.en: On-demand support and permanent access to devices (2 sessions/day for free)
desc.zh: 按需支持和对设备的永久访问（每天免费 2 个会话）

desc.en: Open source virtual/remote desktop infrastructure for everyone!
desc.zh: 面向所有人的开源虚拟/远程桌面基础设施！
